messages:
maria: Heads-up — customer reported 403s on SSO right after their IdP rotated certs. App sees 'Assertion signature verification failed'. Can someone triage?

sam-iam: Which error exactly? entityID + ACS URL and a snippet of the log would help.

maria: Log: 
```
2026-03-17T09:02:14Z ERROR auth.saml verify failed assertion=abcd1234 err='Signature verification failed' fingerprint_expected='SHA1:AA:BB:CC:11' fingerprint_seen='SHA1:DD:EE:FF:22'
```
EntityID: https://idp.examplecorp.com/saml2 Metadata URL: https://idp.examplecorp.com/metadata.xml ACS: https://app.redwood.ai/sso/acs

jonathan: Two quick targets: 1) Is our metadata fetch pulling the new cert? 2) Check for metadata lastUpdated/validUntil anomalies (clock skew). Also some IdPs reorder KeyDescriptor certs during rotation which breaks exact-fingerprint matching.

maria: Pulled their metadata XML, snippet below — note the cert block order:
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.examplecorp.com/saml2" validUntil="2026-04-01T00:00:00Z">
  <IDPSSODescriptor>
    <KeyDescriptor use="signing">
      <ds:KeyInfo>
        <ds:X509Data>
          <ds:X509Certificate>MIIF...NEWCERT...</ds:X509Certificate>
          <ds:X509Certificate>MIIF...OLDCERT...</ds:X509Certificate>
        </ds:X509Data>
      </ds:KeyInfo>
    </KeyDescriptor>
  </IDPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
They swapped new+old order during rotation. Our verifier was matching only the first fingerprint. Also their metadata's lastUpdated header is `2026-03-17T09:05:00Z` while our server clock is 30s behind. Could be TTL/cache chasing.

kevin-eng: I can flush the metadata cache for that entityID. Quick mitigation: accept any cert in KeyDescriptor when computing expected fingerprints (we should PR this). For now I'll flush and request the customer retry.

support-bot: metadata-cache: flush started for entityID=https://idp.examplecorp.com/saml2 by kevin-eng

kevin-eng: Done — cache cleared and immediate refetch shows new metadata with certificates (order unchanged on new fetch).

maria: Customer retried and auths are succeeding again — they see 200s. :white_check_mark:

jonathan: Follow-up action items: 1) short-term: update verification to compare against all certificates in KeyDescriptor (not just first) 2) add small clock-skew tolerance when validating metadata lastUpdated/validUntil 3) add alert when metadata cert fingerprint mismatches on refetch.

kevin-eng: I'll open the PR for multi-cert matching and a test case for swapped order.

maria: Thanks team. I'll update the customer and close the escalation once PR is in review. :thumbsup:
